name: MCPS Work-Based Learning Internship (for credit)
org: Montgomery County Public Schools, Work-Based Learning Office
note: Re-verified against the district's own work-based learning page on 2026-09-08. The three course options and their hour requirements are confirmed; the page publishes no grade floor, pay information or deadline, so those stay unknown.

offerings.summary: MCPS students work outside school in a practical placement and earn advanced level credit, taking the internship as a single, double or triple period course worth 75, 150 or 225 hours a semester.

school.raw: Students enrol through the internship coordinator at their MCPS high school.

sched.dur_raw: Internship A/B Single Period (WBL2014); 75 hours per semester. Internship A/B Double Period (WBL2015); 150 hours per semester. Internship A/B Triple Period (WBL2026); 225 per semester

app.instructions: Contact the internship coordinator at your MCPS high school.

issues: The page names no grade levels.
The page does not say whether placements are paid; students already working can convert existing employment to credit, which implies some are.

sources.title: Internship for Students | Montgomery County Public Schools

evidence.quote: An internship is a practical learning experience outside of the normal classroom setting.
Internship A/B Single Period (WBL2014); 75 hours per semester; Internship A/B Double Period (WBL2015); 150 hours per semester; Internship A/B Triple Period (WBL2026); 225 per semester
